scientific_summary: MusiCoT trains a single text-conditioned semantic LM on coarse-first CLAP RVQ thought tokens followed by audio tokens. CLAP embeddings of 10-second clips yield analyzable intermediate musical thoughts.
invariants: Thoughts are continuous CLAP embeddings represented by RVQ tokens, not natural-language reasoning.
For M clips and L codebooks, flatten all M tokens of level 1, then level 2, through level L; do not flatten clip by clip.
LM predicts thought tokens before audio tokens; training uses CE for both token domains.
Dual temperatures T₁/T₂ and CFG scales λ₁/λ₂ belong to thought/audio domains, respectively.
CLAP internals and fixed/trainable flags are not specified in the supplied excerpt; do not invent them. RVQ is trained by reconstruction quantization loss.
Analysis reconstructs quantized CLAP vectors and compares cosine similarity to relevant text anchors; heatmap is schematic, not experiment data.
Diagram output stops at audio tokens, as supplied Methodology; do not invent a direct CLAP audio decoder.
layout: A complete rectangular equal-division 3×3 matrix within one landscape frame. All nine component panels are identical 440×260 rectangles. Top row left-to-right: Music Audio, CLAP Embeddings, Coarse-to-Fine RVQ. Middle row: Text Tokens, Dual Sampling, Semantic LM. Bottom row: Structural Analysis, Audio Tokens, Musical Thoughts. The semantic chain turns downward at the right edge; predicted thoughts feed audio tokens leftward. Analysis and control are fully reserved equal cells, never dangling footers. Read the actual arrow directions, without invented row-wide buses. Use one white outer frame x40–1640/y50–1120, title above. Two inter-row gutters and one bottom analysis lane contain only specified arrows and concise captions. Native scientific microviews differentiate content inside the shared rectangular framework. DIRECT-CONTENT INSET: In Music Audio panel, reserve one pure white axis-aligned empty rectangle x90,y155,width380,height137. It is the only intentional blank region. Draw no waveform, signal, tick marks, placeholder icon, hatch, frame or text inside it. The actual measured waveform is composited there after generation. Outside that rectangle draw the Music Audio heading on the common top baseline and Input example at y130, in readable dark text. Do not add a fictitious input specimen elsewhere. The panel and its east outgoing arrow remain intact; other eight panels retain native symbolic scientific content.
typography: Arial, dark near-black text; 28–30 px unnumbered panel headings, 21–24 px essential labels, consistent baselines. Real subscripts and superscripts. No tiny gray notes. Keep schematic marker readable and dark.
